items.title: Virtual outputs on Windows
items.text: vyz and rakk send their picture straight to mapp and other Spout apps, with no window to capture. lynk can patch them.

items.title: mapp is out
items.text: Projection mapping with surfaces, masks, edge blending and cues.

items.title: Always live
items.text: No Go live button. Outputs open automatically.

items.title: Virtual outputs on Mac
items.text: The same no-window video sharing on macOS, over Syphon.

items.title: NDI
items.text: Send and receive video between machines on the network.

items.title: Ableton Link
items.text: Share tempo with Ableton Live and other Link apps.

items.title: LTC out
items.text: Send timecode out as audio from lynk.

items.title: HAP playback
items.text: Smooth playback of HAP encoded video, which konv can already make.

items.title: Multi-pass ISF shaders
items.text: Support for ISF shaders with more than one pass.

items.title: 3D model mapping
items.text: Map onto 3D objects as well as flat surfaces.

items.title: konv on Intel Macs
items.text: A macOS build for Intel Macs as well as Apple Silicon.

items.title: Notch LC
items.text: Convert to Notch LC, the GPU-friendly codec for media servers.

items.title: HAP built in
items.text: HAP, HAP Q and HAP Alpha straight from the install, without downloading a separate FFmpeg build.

items.title: Notch Blocks
items.text: Load Notch Blocks in vyz and play them like any other clip.

items.title: Signed installers
items.text: Code-signed installers, so Windows and macOS stop warning the first time you open an app.
